whyThisMatters:
Directory that lists open-source alternatives to popular proprietary software. ~12,000 estimated users. Founded Feb 2024, Poland. Sells ad placements: Silver 147 dollars a month (~90k impressions), Gold 297 dollars a month (~350k), Platinum 597 dollars a month (~650k). 24 active subscriptions.

A list of software, monetised with old-school sponsor slots. No product to support, no churn drama — just SEO traffic and dev-tool companies paying monthly to be seen. Revenue has been flat-to-up every month for a year, which is exactly what "boring" should look like.

The ads are the product. A company pays to sit next to the list, in three sizes. The subscription count is those slots, not the number of people reading. The founder puts the reader count much higher. The company is in Poland. The monthly cash has stayed in a band for a year, which is the part worth keeping.
